concerns.text: FR-004 requires a Partial Pearson correlation analysis, but the only statistical task (T020a) implements Multiple Linear Regression (OLS). No task provides the mandated Partial Pearson correlation, resulting in a gap between the specification and the task list.

FR-011 mandates the use of a validated cognitive flexibility instrument (e.g., WCST) with a citable validation. No task in the current list verifies or documents the validation status of the WCST instrument, leaving this functional requirement uncovered.
